notes:
This confirms it: "underwater basket weaving" is a real craft technique and hobby brand, but it is not a children's/toddler class — the actual programs I found are recommended for ages 12+, and there is nothing offered for toddlers by anyone, in Halton Hills or elsewhere. The Halton Hills recreation programs I found cover swimming, dance, and skateboarding for kids, but nothing matching this subject for toddlers.
